user.title: Add room alarm endpoint
user.description: Configure one room with a primary Assist satellite/media-player pair and optional additional pairs. Scheduler Component must already be installed and configured.

data_description.name: A friendly room/endpoint name, such as Bedroom.
data_description.area_id: Optional Home Assistant area for this endpoint.
data_description.assist_satellite_entity_id: The primary Assist satellite for this room.
data_description.media_player_entity_id: The media player paired with the primary Assist satellite.
data_description.additional_assist_satellite_entity_ids: Optional additional satellites in the same room. Selection order is paired with the additional media-player selection.
data_description.additional_media_player_entity_ids: Optional additional media players. Select the same number as additional satellites and in matching order.

error.scheduler_not_ready: Scheduler Component is not ready. Install it, add the Scheduler integration, and make sure its scheduler.add/edit/remove actions are available.
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity is not currently available.
error.playback_target_count_mismatch: Select the same number of additional Assist satellites and additional media players.
error.duplicate_satellite: The same Assist satellite cannot be selected twice in one room.
error.duplicate_media_player: The same media player cannot be selected twice in one room.
error.satellite_already_in_room: One of the selected Assist satellites already belongs to another Satellite Alarms room endpoint.

abort.already_configured: This primary Assist satellite is already configured as a Satellite Alarms room endpoint.

init.title: Alarm defaults
init.description: Configure room playback mode, snooze, target volume, ramp, media, and timeout defaults.

data_description.default_volume: Target volume from 0.0 to 1.0. If volume ramping is enabled, this is the end of the ramp. Previous speaker volume is restored after the alarm.
data_description.default_snooze_minutes: Minutes used when the user says Snooze without specifying a duration.
data_description.volume_ramp_enabled: Gradually increase volume when alarms begin ringing.
data_description.volume_ramp_start: Starting volume for the gradual wake ramp.
data_description.volume_ramp_seconds: How long the volume ramp should take.
data_description.max_ring_minutes: Stop an unanswered alarm after this many minutes.
data_description.default_alarm_media: Optional media URL or Home Assistant media reference. When set, the alarm repeats this media through assist_satellite.announce.
data_description.default_alarm_message: Spoken fallback used when no alarm media is configured.
data_description.playback_mode: Primary only uses the primary pair. All room speakers rings every available pair. Primary with fallback tries the primary pair first, then additional pairs when needed.
